notablePrerequisites: Optionally, you control an additional creature with power 2 or greater.
description:
Cast Cut Your Losses by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing the player named by Sewer Nemesis to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the player to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, milling the remainder of their library.
